content.content: When invoked as `deccy redo` while the redo tail holds the operation, the deccy CLI shall revert the reverts `deccy undo` recorded.
content.rationale: Reverting the recorded reverts is what the redo leg promises; stating the happy path against the redo tail gives the gate something to bound. The linear history makes the tail the markers at and after the position, and a new operation discards it.
